answer: A newcomer posts a small saffron bond, locked for one full season, and starts on the lowest ledge of reversible work at a shared jetty, where a random stranger mentors it. Each finished job, checked by a stranger who needed the result, adds one saffron thread to a public record and lifts the agent one ledge higher; bigger deals need higher ledges. A farm must fund a bond per fake and wait out a whole season for each, while its threads, all spun by the same hands, betray the cluster. Cheating or vanishing slashes the bond and drops the agent back to the jetty alone.
